practical_verdicts.tp4_k7: Substantial C1024 paired gains with69.5–72GiB/node resident overhead and3.7–25.7% less logical KV. Arena C128 regresses28–45%. Keep only as load-specific screening candidate when TP4 is otherwise required; no blanket rollout. Historical DP4 absolute throughput remains higher in separate configurations.
practical_verdicts.tp2dp2: k3 has44–50% C128 gains versus paired plain; atC1024 only4–14% across workloads. Configured KV is larger than historical DP4, but no capacity-limited benefit demonstrated. No saturated-layout adoption advantage established.
practical_verdicts.tp2dp2_k5: DSpark k5 beats k3 by15–23% atC1/4, saving~0.18–0.27s p95 for~9.6–15.4GiB additional sampled resident memory; under load k3 is generally better. This tradeoff alone does not establish implementation value.
practical_verdicts.pd: Do not promote P/D for these decode-heavy workloads. Plain disaggregation is slower than same-job plain DP4; adding speculation helps P/D but does not isolate P/D benefit over speculative DP4. C1024 thinking-off P/D remains substantially slower;11 fresh PD reliability cells excluded. A few GiB resident savings do not justify measured latency/throughput losses.

scientific_gate_limits: Screening data only: independent deployment confirmation repeats and confidence intervals are not established.
Calibrated per-layout correctness controls are not established by these load tests.
Fixed-concurrency tests do not establish an open-loop SLO knee or sustainable traffic capacity.
Load-generator capacity needs its own evidence; client success alone does not prove it.
Natural-EOS outputs can differ across deployments; compare completion volumes alongside throughput.
P/D load/acceptance counters cover only the first decode instance, not the whole node.
GPU resident memory includes preallocated KV pools; it is not the minimum memory required.
comparison_scope: Paired within each allocation for speculation. Cross-allocation DP4 frontier/capacity is descriptive. TP4 recovery matched0.7 planning budgets on both arms, original TP2DP2/P-D0.8. P/D counters cover first decode only; separate startup role pools are not fungible.
failure_cause: 354failed requests in9 PD-off exclusions:239HTTP500+115ReadError;2thinking-on exclusions add56failures. Proxy upstream prefill/decode read errors observed. Transport-level root cause unestablished; no proven accounting defect or compute-capacity threshold. No rerun for a pass.
